intent: Write JUnit 5 + AssertJ tests (reactor-test StepVerifier for Mono/Flux, Mockito for collaborators, no external services, no Thread.sleep) for SensorMetricBoundary. Assert ONLY against the ast_hints method table; at least one given/when/then case per table method and per branch. Unit contract: Context Telemetry Ingestion & Validation. Immutable record Sensor Metric Boundary (physical limit of a metric, Source of truth of boundary definitions, supplied by configuration and bound through TelemetryProperties). Rules: accepts(value) is true when disabled; otherwise min <= value <= max, with value > min when minExclusive (swim pace must be strictly above its minimum). Pure domain logic, no framework imports.

methods.signature: SensorMetricBoundary(MetricKind metric, double min, double max, boolean minExclusive, boolean enabled)
methods.semantics: Null rejected (NullPointerException); metric non-null; min must be <= max (IllegalArgumentException otherwise); when enabled is false the range is ignored.
True when value == min is outside the boundary.
False means the metric is unbounded.

Signal: true = value is inside the boundary (min inclusive unless minExclusive, max inclusive) or the boundary is disabled; false = Sensor Metric Boundary violated. Consumers MUST handle both branches: on_true the sample is tagged VALID, on_false it is tagged VALIDATION_FAILED and still propagated.
